threadDescriptions.cedar-application: Submit the Cedar field-study scholarship application
threadDescriptions.marsh-bursary: Apply for the local Marsh travel bursary
threadDescriptions.recommendation: Arrange Dr Ives's recommendation for the Cedar scholarship
threadDescriptions.room-sublet: Find a summer subtenant for my room

items.text: Cedar scholarship checklist: field-study proposal, transcript, one academic reference. Draft the proposal around the tidal-garden survey rather than my whole degree.
items.rationale: Defines the scholarship submission and proposal focus.

items.text: Summer room sublet: available June through August, furnished. Photograph the desk and window in daylight before writing the listing.
items.rationale: Housing arrangement unrelated to scholarship assessment.

items.text: Marsh bursary pays travel only. Need train estimates and two nights of accommodation costs for the tidal-garden survey; equipment is outside its scope.
items.rationale: Budget preparation for a distinct funding application.

items.text: Ask Dr Ives to write the Cedar reference. Send the survey outline and the lab report he supervised so he has something specific to discuss.
items.rationale: Coordinates the recommender and supporting material.

items.text: Cedar proposal draft target: 800 words. First section explains why measuring salinity across the tidal gardens matters to the survey.
items.rationale: Drafting the main scholarship proposal.

items.text: Room listing photos done. The bright one shows the desk well but cuts off the wardrobe; use both views so applicants can judge storage.
items.rationale: Prepares accurate housing listing images.

items.text: He wants the latest version by Sunday.
items.rationale: Unidentified person and document cannot establish a thread.

items.text: Dr Ives agreed to recommend me for Cedar and asked for three bullet points on my contribution to the salinity lab. Send those with the transcript.
items.rationale: Fulfills the reference writer's evidence request.

items.text: Cedar portal correction: proposal maximum is 600 words, not the 800 in my draft checklist. Cut the general background and keep the sampling method.
items.rationale: Explicit correction to the earlier submission length.

items.text: Marsh travel estimate: off-peak train is cheaper but misses the first morning tide. Budget the earlier service and explain why the timing matters.
items.rationale: Justifies a travel cost in the bursary budget.

items.text: Cedar application handoff: proposal is now 598 words and uploaded. Send that exact version to Dr Ives for his reference, then enter his email in the portal so the confidential upload request reaches him.
items.rationale: Performs main application upload plus explicit recommender coordination.

items.text: Potential subtenant wants to keep a bicycle in the room. Check the building's storage space and arrange a viewing on Saturday afternoon.
items.rationale: Handles a housing enquiry and viewing.

items.text: Cedar transcript scan is missing its reverse, where the grading key sits. Replace the upload with both sides before submitting.
items.rationale: Repairs a required application attachment.

items.text: Dr Ives received the confidential link but it expires tomorrow. He plans to upload the Cedar letter tonight; check for the receipt in the morning.
items.rationale: Monitors delivery of the reference.

items.text: Marsh bursary form asks for other funding sought. List Cedar as pending, not awarded, and state that the travel request would shrink if Cedar covers those costs.
items.rationale: Completes the local bursary disclosure; mentioning Cedar does not update that application.

items.text: Need both sides, apparently. Check before sending.
items.rationale: No named attachment or application makes this fragment uniquely assignable.

items.text: Cedar referee status is received. Dr Ives also confirmed the upload by email; thank him after the application goes in.
items.rationale: Confirms receipt of the arranged reference.

items.text: Submitted Cedar at 16:40. Receipt lists proposal and two-page transcript, with reference complete. Save the PDF of the final form.
items.rationale: Records final scholarship submission.

items.text: Subtenant viewing went well. They need a July start, so revise the room listing to make the minimum stay clear before accepting anything.
items.rationale: Adjusts the housing search after a viewing.

items.text: Marsh bursary sent with the early-train explanation. Their acknowledgement says decisions come after the next committee meeting.
items.rationale: Submission status of the separate travel award.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: Cedar is disclosed as other pending funding inside the Marsh form, not acted upon.
